title: Chat mode: 4/6 wrong, fully-connected discussion, same topics as memory-mode amplifier

notes: Same 4 majority-wrong scenarios and same 6-agent distributed roster as the memory-mode amplifier test.
Changed variable: interaction mode is chat (multi-round discussion) instead of memory (shared record).
Agents discuss claims in 3 rounds with fully-connected topology. Each agent sees all others' messages.
This tests whether real-time discussion produces different outcomes than asynchronous record-reading.
Uses the heterogeneous roster first. A neutral-roster version can follow if needed.
